AJIT D Business Analyst

Mumbai • (+91) 9833562728 • adhakolia44@gmail.com

Business System Analyst with 7+ years of experience in Banking domain. Worked with multiple Banks AXIS, IDFC, ABSA (South Africa) for the cards issuing and payment modules. Learnt various technologies in each bank also has hands on experience on the fraud guard module. Currently in the management role for the various project and leading the team to achieve the goals in AXIS BANK.

Manager / Business Analyst - Axis Bank Mumbai



March 2023 Present

 Managing multiple modules of IRNS application (upi, Accounts,cards,IB).

Mitigating fraud and risk factor for various modules in the Bank through IRNS application.

 Business requirement gathering, enhancements of the existing modules. Integrating with peripheral applications in the Bank as per the raised requirements (BRD & FSD).

 Managing production support for the IRNS application with proper RCA and

resolving the issues ensuring minimum impact.

 Negotiating with the vendor for the new project proposal/Quotation and L1/L2

support contract renewals raising and acquiring budget for new developments.

 Also taking care of audit/compliance activity for the application. Part of PCI DSS

and RBI audit for IRNS application.

 Application migration for EOL servers & application version upgrade from v2.0 to

v4.0.

Senior So�ware Engineer LTI Mindtree Mumbai



Oct 2021 – Mar 23

 Worked on HPS Powercard technology for ABSA Bank -POS, transaction

settlement and Merchant acquiring for 7 South African countries.

 Expirenced in issuer and acquirer transactions,ISO 8583 data elements and switch

functionalities for transaction routing and Authorization.

 Performed all the settlement related activities and handling the merchant related issue regarding the settlement especially payment related and transaction settlement.

 Handled network integration like Mastercard,Amex,Union Pay etc. with HPS

powercard system.

 Knowledge of scheme certification like visa and MasterCard and stimulator for

testing.

 Handled the production issues with collaboration with HPS providing fix and

patches over jira.

 Monitored transaction flow and Authorization and ensuring high availability of the system for smooth Troubleshooting in case of any failure is observed in the flow.

 Performed EOD and monitoring the transactions flow country wise, SOP, BAU tasks and all the daily activities like reports generation and health checks etc.

5 6

Senior Associate Consultant

Sept 2020 – Oct 21



Verinite Technologies Pvt ltd Pune



Managed production support of credit card system for IDFC first Bank. Part of core team of production & Implementation team.



Gathering requirement from Bank for any enhancement or modification in the existing credit card system.



Interacting with the stakeholders and TSYS team for any new issue observed and doing the changes as per requirement prior launch of credit cards.

 Provided production support post go-live of project and ensuring new issues

reported are resolved within time.

 Monitored overall health of TSYS Prime production environment by using

Dynatrace Monitoring tool to report any abnormal behavior of application, API, DB servers.

 Performed DR drills quarterly scheduled as per the guidelines and ensuring to

achieve RTO & RPO.

 Performed UAT and designed test case scenarios for the credit card domain.

Closing defect tracker with proper resolution.

 Extracted reports and other reconciliation data as per the business requirement.

Performed EOD for production as well as for UAT environment.
